englishLengthSpike.ko: 송다은 씨, 기록을 본 순간 무엇이 가장 먼저 무너졌습니까.

englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Choi, even if your intent was good, do you see your responsibility for the hurt caused?

englishLengthSpike.ko: 두 분, 연락 내용과 해석이 갈린 지점을 따로 정리해 주십시오.
englishLengthSpike.en: Both of you, separately organize the content of the contact and where your interpretations diverged.

englishLengthSpike.ko: 송다은 씨, 호감 표현이 없다는 자료를 보고도 왜 단정했습니까.
englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Song, why did you still conclude that way after seeing material with no expression of romantic interest?

englishLengthSpike.ko: 두 분, 연락의 겉모습과 실제 목적을 구분해 말씀해 주십시오.
englishLengthSpike.en: Both of you, distinguish the outward appearance of the contact from its actual purpose.

englishLengthSpike.ko: 송다은 씨, 연락 기록만으로 결론을 세운 과정을 말씀하십시오.
englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Song, explain the process by which you formed a conclusion from the contact log alone.

englishLengthSpike.ko: 최수민 씨, 보호하려다 오해를 키운 선택을 어떻게 설명하십니까.
englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Choi, how do you explain the choice that was meant to protect her but increased misunderstanding?

englishLengthSpike.ko: 송다은 씨, 결혼 앞 불안이 판단에 얼마나 들어갔습니까.

englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Song, why did the memory of cutting ties in the past outrun your judgment this time?

englishLengthSpike.ko: 송다은 씨, 상대의 설명 가능성을 왜 끝까지 낮게 보셨습니까.
englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Song, why did you keep giving so little weight to the possibility of the other person's explanation?

englishLengthSpike.ko: 최수민 씨, 거절하고도 말하지 못한 압박을 설명해 주십시오.
englishLengthSpike.en: Ms. Choi, explain the pressure you felt after refusing him yet being unable to speak.

englishLengthSpike.ko: 송다은 씨, 선후가 바뀌는 순간 느낀 혼란을 말해 주십시오.

englishLengthSpike.ko: 최수민 씨, 첫 메시지를 받은 뒤 바로 어떤 답을 했습니까.
